effect.shortEffect: The Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
effect.full: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

english.ch: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

japanese.ch: 天気が　にほんばれ状態でなくても にほんばれ状態として 技を使うことができる。
